_readme: Robinhood (4663) PRODUCTION liquidity seed — the on-chain step that turns RH from 'dust demo' into a tradeable production chain. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/robinhood-production.json ./scripts/seed.sh robinhood --broadcast (funded deployer key required — Claude cannot broadcast this). TWO pools: (1) deepen the existing WETH/tHOOK v2 pool so swaps route at normal size; (2) a WETH/USDG v2 pool — the STABLECOIN ANCHOR that unlocks USD prices/TVL/volume across the whole app (the Phase-2 indexer computes usdPerNative from this pool automatically once it exists). AMOUNTS + USDG holdings below are PLACEHOLDERS — they are Reggie's economic call (how much capital to commit). USDG is a REAL token (Global Dollar 0x5fc5360D...), NOT mintable — the deployer must actually hold the USDG + WETH amounts before broadcasting.
_before_you_run: Fund the deployer on Robinhood with: the WETH (or ETH to wrap) for amountA of BOTH pools, and REAL USDG for the WETH/USDG pool, plus gas.
tHOOK (0x3b5a01Ef..) is the already-seeded MockERC20 the deployer already holds ~999.9B of — the deepen pool uses it by ADDRESS so it ADDS to the existing pair.
Set priceAperB for WETH/USDG to the real market rate (USDG per 1 WETH ≈ the live ETH/USD price). The placeholder 3500 is illustrative only.
After broadcast: set data-api chains.ts v3DeployBlock only if you later seed a v3 pool; for these v2 pools nothing else is needed — the indexer discovers them via factory enumeration.

4663.label: WETH / tHOOK v2 — deepen to tradeable size (PLACEHOLDER amounts — set to your capital)
WETH / USDG v2 — STABLECOIN ANCHOR (unlocks USD across the app). USDG is REAL, deployer must hold it. priceAperB = live USDG-per-WETH.
